content_voiceover: This question asks which statement about polycythemia vera is not true. Option A is correct, patients homozygous for JAK2 V617F tend to have longer disease duration, higher hemoglobin levels, more pruritus, and a higher likelihood of transforming to post PV myelofibrosis, reflecting a gene dosage effect. Option B is the false statement to focus on. It claims the marrow shows increased erythroid precursors with normal granulocytic precursors. In reality, PV marrow shows panmyelosis, a hypercellular marrow with increases in all three myeloid lineages, erythroid, granulocytic, and megakaryocytic, not just the erythroid line with a normal granulocytic compartment. Option C is correct, thrombosis is the most common and clinically important complication of PV, occurring in roughly one third of patients over the disease course. Option D is correct, platelet count is elevated in about half of patients at diagnosis, and in about ten percent it exceeds 1000 times 10 to the 9 per liter. Option E is correct, clonality studies using X chromosome inactivation patterns confirm that red cells, granulocytes, platelets, monocytes, and B lymphocytes all arise from the same neoplastic clone, demonstrating that PV originates at the level of a multipotent hematopoietic stem cell.
keypoints: PV marrow shows panmyelosis, hypercellularity across erythroid, granulocytic, and megakaryocytic lineages together
Homozygous JAK2 V617F predicts longer disease duration, higher hemoglobin, and higher risk of post PV myelofibrosis
Thrombosis is the leading complication of PV, occurring in about one third of patients
Platelet count exceeds 1000 times 10 to the 9 per liter in roughly ten percent of patients at diagnosis
X inactivation clonality studies show red cells, granulocytes, platelets, monocytes, and B cells all share the neoplastic clone
keypoint_voiceover: The key teaching point is panmyelosis, PV involves all three myeloid lineages in the marrow, not just erythroid expansion with a normal granulocytic compartment, which is what makes option B the false statement.
